memory-review.json.assessment: Reviewed all 48 groups/96 pairs. All 12 large original-snapshot groups reduce mean peak RSS by 20.33–20.81% (about 9.9–10.2 MB). Small and retained-snapshot results have mixed signs: maximum small mean increase 131072 bytes/1.733%, positive in both observations; maximum large retained mean increase 628736 bytes/0.905%, with paired changes -606208/+1863680. The large retained write-only JIT increase is 448512 bytes/0.644%, positive in both observations. These increases are retained as measured tradeoffs, not dismissed as noise. No persistent frame fields or retained caches are added; operator permissions are saved on the call stack and restored. Allocation controls show no total/slope regression and snapshot semantics pass. Accept this bounded tradeoff with explicit limits: two local observations do not establish memory neutrality, retained-heap bounds, leak freedom or clean-host speed.

from owner import snapshot, edit
let original := snapshot()
mut n := 1
while n <= 16 {
  assert_equal(edit(n), n)
  assert_equal(snapshot()[0], n + 1)
  assert_equal(snapshot()[1], n)
  n += 1
}
assert_equal(original[0], 0)
assert_equal(original[1], 0)

print("OPERATOR ESCAPE PASS")

require 'json'; require 'digest'; require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__)
state={status:'waiting',stage:'normal-release',pid:Process.pid,build_pid:17106}
save=->{File.write(o+'/after-build-state.json',JSON.pretty_generate(state)+"\n")};save.call
run=->(name,args,env={}) {state[:stage]=name;save.call;raise name unless system(env,*args,out:o+'/'+name+'.log',err:[:child,:out])}
begin
 loop do
  lines=File.readlines(o+'/normal-release-artifacts.jsonl'); last=lines.reverse.map{|l|JSON.parse(l) rescue nil}.compact.find{|x|x['reason']=='build-finished'}
  if last
   raise 'Build failed' unless last['success'];break
  end
  begin;Process.kill(0,state[:build_pid]);rescue Errno::ESRCH;raise 'Build exited without completion evidence';end
  sleep 5
 end
 state[:status]='running';save.call
 run.call('matched-target-gates',['ruby',o+'/resume-normal-release.rb','--reuse-build'])
 run.call('callback-controls',['ruby',o+'/check-callback-controls.rb'])
 File.write(o+'/portable-regression-harness.rs',%w[compound_publication compound_unary_publication].map{|name|'#[path = '+File.expand_path('tests/'+name+'.rs').inspect+'] mod '+name+';'}.join("\n")+"\n")
 run.call('portable-build',['rustc','--edition=2021','--test',o+'/portable-regression-harness.rs','-o',o+'/portable-regression-harness'],{'CARGO_BIN_EXE_kujo'=>o+'/candidate-kujo','CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR'=>Dir.pwd})
 run.call('portable-regression',[o+'/portable-regression-harness','--nocapture'])
 state[:status]='target-and-callback-gates-passed';state[:stage]='needs-broad-gates';save.call
rescue=>e;state[:status]='failed';state[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

batch-controls.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3';require 'fileutils'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);base=File.expand_path('../captured-scalar-batch-2026-10-29',o);fixtures=File.expand_path('../array-batch-baseline-2026-10-29',o)
raise 'Invalid baseline' unless system('ruby','benchmarks/langarena/probes/verify-array-batch-isolation.rb',fixtures)
prior=JSON.parse(File.read(fixtures+'/report.json'));out=o+'/batch-controls';raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out);FileUtils.mkdir_p(out)
probes={'baseline'=>base+'/task-allocation-probe','candidate'=>o+'/task-allocation-probe'};binary=o+'/candidate-kujo'
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,identities:(probes.values+[binary,__FILE__]).to_h{|p|[p,Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest]},baseline_report_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(fixtures+'/report.json').hexdigest,sources:prior['sources'],rows:[],semantics:[]}
save=->{File.write(out+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 prior['semantics'].select{|x|x['mode']=='vm'}.each do |old|
  path=old['argv'][2];owner=File.dirname(path)+'/owner.kujo'
  raise 'Fixture changed' unless Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest==old['source_sha256']&&Digest::SHA256.file(owner).hexdigest==old['module_sha256']
  meta=old.reject{|k,v|%w[mode argv exit].include?(k)}
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   args=[binary,'run',path,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
   stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="ARRAY BATCH PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,exit:status.exitstatus)
  end
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   row=meta.merge(mode:mode)
   probes.each do |kind,probe|
    args=[probe,mode,path];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="ARRAY BATCH PASS\n"
    m=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise stderr unless m
    row[kind]={argv:args,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i}
   end
   r[:rows]<<row
  end
  save.call
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==288&&r[:semantics].size==432
 r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'Identity drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

check-callback-controls.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__)
source=File.expand_path('../compound-batch-2026-10-29/operator-attribution/callback-body/report.json',o)
prior=JSON.parse(File.read(source)); raise 'Prior incomplete' unless prior['status']=='characterized'
probe=File.expand_path(ARGV.fetch(0,o+'/task-allocation-probe'));bin=File.expand_path(ARGV.fetch(1,o+'/candidate-kujo'))
sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
r={status:'running',reference:source,reference_sha256:sha.call(source),probe_sha256:sha.call(probe),binary_sha256:sha.call(bin),rows:[],semantics:[]}
output=File.expand_path(ARGV.fetch(2,o+'/callback-controls.json'));raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(output)
save=->{File.write(output,JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 raise 'Coverage' unless prior['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at('body','calls','mode')}.sort==%w[return-only snapshot-only write-only assert-only].product([1,16],%w[vm jit]).sort
 prior['rows'].each do |row|
  base=row.fetch('baseline');path=base.fetch('argv').last
  raise 'Baseline identity' unless sha.call(base['argv'][0])==prior['identities']['baseline']
  raise 'Fixture drift' unless sha.call(path)==row['source_sha256']&&sha.call(File.dirname(path)+'/owner.kujo')==row['module_sha256']
  m=base['stderr'].match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
  raise 'Baseline execution' unless base['exit']==0&&base['stdout']=="OPERATOR ESCAPE PASS\n"&&m&&m[1].to_i==base['requests']&&m[2].to_i==base['bytes']
  argv=[probe,row['mode'],path];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*argv);counts=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
  raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout==base['stdout']&&counts
  r[:rows]<<{body:row['body'],calls:row['calls'],mode:row['mode'],argv:argv,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus,requests:counts[1].to_i,bytes:counts[2].to_i,request_delta:counts[1].to_i-base['requests'],byte_delta:counts[2].to_i-base['bytes']};save.call
 end
 prior['rows'].map{|x|x['baseline']['argv'].last}.uniq.each do |path|
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   argv=[bin,'run',path,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode]);stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*argv)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="OPERATOR ESCAPE PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<{argv:argv,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus};save.call
  end
 end

 %w[parameter read_only write_only increment_return].product(smoke ? [8] : [8,32768],smoke ? ['retained'] : %w[once retained]).each do |counter,width,snapshot|

save=->{File.write(output,JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 cases=reference['rows'].map{|x|x.slice('operation','counter','width','snapshot','calls','source_sha256','module_sha256')}.uniq
 raise 'Case set' unless cases.length==64
 cases.each do |meta|
  path=prior+'/'+meta.values_at('operation','counter','width','snapshot','calls').join('-')+'/main.kujo'
  {'source_sha256'=>path,'module_sha256'=>File.dirname(path)+'/owner.kujo'}.each{|key,p|h=Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest;raise 'Fixture drift' unless h==meta[key];r[:sources][p]=h}
  r[:stage]=path;save.call
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   args=[bin,'run',path,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
   stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="COMPOUND CAPTURE PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus);save.call
  end
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   args=[probe,mode,path];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);counts=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="COMPOUND CAPTURE PASS\n"&&counts
   r[:rows]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus,requests:counts[1].to_i,bytes:counts[2].to_i);save.call
  end
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].length==128&&r[:semantics].length==192
 r[:slopes]=r[:rows].group_by{|x|x.values_at('operation','counter','width','snapshot',:mode)}.map do |group,rows|
  a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']};{group:group,requests:(b[:requests]-a[:requests]).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls']),bytes:(b[:bytes]-a[:bytes]).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls'])}
 end
 raise 'Binary drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(bin).hexdigest==r[:binary_sha256]&&Digest::SHA256.file(probe).hexdigest==r[:probe_sha256]
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call
 puts label+':128 allocation observations/192 semantic cases completed'

end

keys=%w[operation counter width snapshot calls mode]
cases=%w[direct compound].product(%w[parameter read_only write_only increment_return],[128,2048],%w[once fresh],[16,32])
[base,candidate].each do |r|
 raise 'Incomplete' unless r['status']=='characterized'

 raise 'Artifacts' unless r['binary_sha256']==Digest::SHA256.file(r['binary']).hexdigest && r['probe_sha256']==Digest::SHA256.file(r['probe']).hexdigest
 raise 'Allocation coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.product(%w[vm jit]).map{|a,b|a+[b]}.sort
 raise 'Semantic coverage' unless r['semantics'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.product(%w[vm interpreter jit]).map{|a,b|a+[b]}.sort
 (r['rows']+r['semantics']).each do |x|
  fixture=File.expand_path('../compound-capture-e445-2026-10-29',o)+'/'+x.values_at(*keys.first(5)).join('-')+'/main.kujo'
  {'source_sha256'=>fixture,'module_sha256'=>File.dirname(fixture)+'/owner.kujo'}.each{|k,p|raise 'Fixture drift' unless x[k]==Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest&&r['sources'][p]==x[k]}
  argv=x.key?('requests') ? [r['probe'],x['mode'],fixture] : [r['binary'],'run',fixture,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(x['mode']=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+x['mode']])
  raise 'Execution' unless x['argv']==argv&&x['exit']==0&&x['stdout']=="COMPOUND CAPTURE PASS\n"
  if x.key?('requests');m=x['stderr'].match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise 'Counters' unless m&&m[1].to_i==x['requests']&&m[2].to_i==x['bytes'];end
 end
 slopes=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at(*keys.first(4),'mode')}.map do |g,rows|
  a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']};{'group'=>g,'requests'=>(b['requests']-a['requests']).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls']),'bytes'=>(b['bytes']-a['bytes']).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls'])}
 end
 raise 'Slope arithmetic' unless slopes==r['slopes']
end

slope_regressions=candidate['slopes'].select{|x|a=slopes.fetch(x['group']);x['requests']>a['requests']||x['bytes']>a['bytes']}
targets=candidate['slopes'].select{|x|x['group'][0]=='compound'&&x['group'][3]=='once'}.group_by{|x|[x['group'][1],x['group'][4]]}.map do |g,rows|
 a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x['group'][2]};{group:g,flat:a['bytes']==b['bytes'],improved:b['bytes']<slopes.fetch(b['group'])['bytes'],bytes:b['bytes']}
end
passed=regressions.empty?&&slope_regressions.empty?&&targets.size==8&&targets.all?{|x|x[:flat]&&x[:improved]}
